title: Clinical Research Coordinator Associate - Pediatrics, Endocrinology

cond_0001.intro: The Department of Pediatrics, Division of Endocrinology is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate to perform duties related to the coordination of clinical studies. Coordinate moderately complex aspects of one or more clinical studies. Work under the close direction of the principal investigator and/or study coordinator/supervisor.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Duties include: Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies. Coordinate studies from startup through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing and implementing a variety of recruitment strategies. Coordinate collection of study specimens and processing. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions and ensure institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Conduct study visits and semi-structured interviews, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Assist in coding qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and participating in the coding process. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
Other duties may also be assigned
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Two-year college degree and two years related work experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
[Company name masked] IRB Knowledge
Strong interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Preferred Requirements
Spanish speaking, as there will be monolingual Spanish participants in our studies.
Previous use of [Product name masked]
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*:
Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping. Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk-based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds. Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

cond_0186.responsibilities:
Serve as the primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies on a daily basis. Coordinate studies from startup through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing and implementing a variety of recruitment strategies. Coordinate collection of study specimens and processing. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Conduct study visits and semi-structured interviews, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Assist in coding qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and participating in the coding process. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets, and resolve billing issues by staying in regular contact with finance and/or management staff. Connect with the principal investigator regularly, raising any patient safety concerns and ensuring adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits, handling questions and walking reviewers through study documentation as needed.
Other duties may also be assigned
cond_0186.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Two-year college degree and two years related work experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
[Company name masked] IRB Knowledge
Strong interpersonal skills, including comfort communicating regularly with participants, sponsors, and study staff.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Preferred Requirements
Spanish speaking, as there will be monolingual Spanish participants in our studies.
Previous use of [Product name masked].
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*:
Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping. Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk-based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds. Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.
Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.
WORKING CONDITIONS:
Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious disease and infections.
cond_0186.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0186.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

Coordinate moderately complex aspects of one or more clinical studies. Work under the close direction of the principal investigator and/or study coordinator/supervisor. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of clinical research processes and regulatory requirements the work involves.
cond_0265.responsibilities:
Duties include: Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies. Coordinate studies from startup through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing and implementing a variety of recruitment strategies. Coordinate collection of study specimens and processing. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions and ensure institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Conduct study visits and semi-structured interviews, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Assist in coding qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and participating in the coding process. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
Other duties may also be assigned
cond_0265.requirements:
[Company name masked] IRB Knowledge
Spanish Speaking preferred
Two-year college degree and two years related work experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Previous use of [Product name masked] (preferred not required)
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping. Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk-based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds. Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

WORKING CONDITIONS:
Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious disease and infections. Spanish speaking is preferred, as there will be monolingual Spanish participants in our studies.

cond_0294.intro: The Department of Pediatrics, Division of Endocrinology is looking for a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate to handle coordination of clinical studies. This role involves regular contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies, and works closely with the principal investigator and/or study coordinator/supervisor on moderately complex aspects of one or more studies.
cond_0294.responsibilities:
Serve as the primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies on a daily basis. Coordinate studies from startup through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing and implementing a variety of recruitment strategies. Coordinate collection of study specimens and processing. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Conduct study visits and semi-structured interviews, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Assist in coding qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and participating in the coding process. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets, and resolve billing issues by staying in regular contact with finance and/or management staff. Connect with the principal investigator regularly, raising any patient safety concerns and ensuring adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits, handling questions and walking reviewers through study documentation as needed.

The role involves regular contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies, and works closely with the principal investigator and/or study coordinator/supervisor on moderately complex aspects of one or more studies.
cond_0465.responsibilities:
Serve as the primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies on a regular basis. Coordinate studies from startup through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Actively assist in developing and implementing a variety of recruitment strategies. Coordinate collection of study specimens and processing. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Conduct study visits and semi-structured interviews, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Assist in coding qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and participating in the coding process. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets, and resolve billing issues by staying in close contact with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
Other duties may also be assigned
cond_0465.requirements:
[Company name masked] IRB Knowledge
Spanish speaking preferred, as there will be monolingual Spanish participants in the studies.
Two-year college degree and two years related work experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Previous use of [Product name masked] (preferred, not required)
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

You will take charge of moderately complex aspects of one or more studies, working under the direction of the principal investigator and/or study coordinator/supervisor.
cond_0494.responsibilities:
Duties include:
Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies.
Lead studies from startup through close-out.
Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol.
Drive development and implementation of a variety of recruitment strategies.
Direct collection of study specimens and processing.
Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects.
Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms.
Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents.
Prepare regulatory submissions and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.
Execute study visits and semi-structured interviews, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact.
Lead coding of qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and the coding process.
Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff.
Engage with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct.
Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements.
Lead participation in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
Other duties may also be assigned

[Company name masked] IRB Knowledge

cond_0630.responsibilities:
Serve as a shared point of contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies.
Coordinate studies from startup through close-out in collaboration with the study team.
Work with the team to determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol.
Support the development and implementation of a variety of recruitment strategies.
Coordinate collection of study specimens and processing.
Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects in coordination with team members.
Help manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms.
Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents.
Prepare regulatory submissions and help ensure institutional Review Board renewals are completed.
Conduct study visits and semi-structured interviews, coordinate scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, serving as a shared point of contact.
Assist in coding qualitative interviews, data-cleaning, and participating in the coding process.
Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and work with finance and/or management staff to resolve billing issues.
Coordinate regularly with the principal investigator to help ensure patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct.
Help ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements.
Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
Other duties may also be assigned
cond_0630.requirements:
[Company name masked] IRB Knowledge
Spanish Speaking preferred
Two-year college degree and two years related work experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Previous use of [Product name masked] (preferred not required)
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*:
Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping. Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk-based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds. Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.
